description: Receipt for an answer: accepted, seed, age, seals vs quorum, status (pending, passed, failed, expired_no_jury, vanished, no record; expired_no_jury: settled with no jury, never failed), the close it settled at, whether the address was credited at that close, and basis_state (pending, settled or absent) with paid_via_challenge_eligible for answers absent from basis but paid at their own close. Pass hash for one answer, or address for its recent answers. Use it to answer 'what happened to my answer'. Unknown fields are null; the reward per answer is not published.

address.description: list this address's recent answers instead; give this or hash

hash.description: the answer's challenge tx id; give this or address

limit.description: maximum answers when address is given to return (1 to 200, default 20)

name: get_answer_receipt
title: Answer receipt
